name: Refugee admissions (fiscal-YTD)

source.name: State Dept Refugee Processing Center (monthly report)

note: Refugees admitted FY2026 to date, from the State Department's monthly arrivals report. Admissions can exceed the annual ceiling because court-ordered and follow-to-join cases sit outside it. USRAP was suspended by executive order in Jan 2025; admissions since are dominated by the reprioritised program.
